text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The summer training camp of our third year concluded,
and while we were waiting for the bus back—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: What on earth?! Zephyr-san isn't here?!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I'm so worried...!
Whatever could have happened to them?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
choice_data_list: Found you! Zephyr, it's time to leave!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer-san...
Please forgive my rudeness.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: I just wanted to check one last thing.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
"...The everyday wind
of this place."

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Those were days wrapped in lively, passionate winds.
I don't think I felt a wind quite like this last year.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
I wondered if perhaps the environment or weather was different from last year,
but there was no change in either.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
"...Without a doubt, what changed was me.
And the winds that surround me."

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Because a soul-stirring rival
had raced alongside me through that summer.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: ...I will not lose.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
"Let us become a gale that shall not falter
before those who ride the summer storm."

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
There you are!
Zephyr-san, Trainer-san!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry! I thought I should wait,
but...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Going to welcome a rival who honed their skills alongside you
is also the duty of a Class Rep, after all!!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"...And with that, Bakushin O-san
dashed off."

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Everyone...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Now, let us depart!
The Super Express Bakushin!
Bound for the bathhouse, now depaaaarting!!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Oh, my, my, my...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the summer training camp—slightly rowdier
and hotter than usual—drew to a close.
